title: Barnes Hut Galaxy Forge
prompt: Create a p5.js N-body galaxy forge in function sketch(p, ctx). Simulate thousands of stars orbiting two movable galactic cores using a Barnes-Hut quadtree rather than all-pairs gravity. Preserve long-lived spiral structure with a stable symplectic integration step, softening near collisions, and mass-weighted initial orbital velocities. Drag a core to disturb the system; click empty space to launch a compact star cluster. Expose starCount, gravityStrength, theta, softening, trailFade, and timeStep through ctx.params. Visualize quadtree cells only while the Q key is held and colour stars by orbital speed.
